about: Places whose realm has been checked against a source, so a rebuild or a Cliopatria update can't quietly undo a fix. `npm run check` fails when the map no longer draws `realm` there in every year of `years` (a realm drawn on top of it, such as an enclave's neighbour, is allowed). `realm: null` means the land must be blank. Use `node scripts/who.mjs <lon>,<lat> <from> <to>` to see what the map draws.
